lines.text: Do you know how a combination lock works? Behind the dial there's a stack of wheels, each with a tiny notch.
Turning the dial spins the first wheel. A small pin on it catches the next wheel, and then the next. That's why you spin it a few times first.
Then you stop at each number in turn, and each wheel ends up with its notch at the top.
When all the notches line up, a bar called the fence drops into the gap, and the shackle pops open.
Get one number wrong, and the fence has nowhere to go. With forty numbers and three wheels, that's sixty four thousand combinations to guess.
Orbi locks files too. A locked file needs its passcode, and after twelve wrong tries, it locks for good.
